scripts.build:wasm: if command -v cargo >/dev/null 2>&1; then cargo build --manifest-path wasm/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && bunx wasm-opt --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int -Oz wasm/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/n_cel_engine.wasm -o src/cel_engine.wasm; elif [ -f src/cel_engine.wasm ]; then echo 'Using committed src/cel_engine.wasm'; else echo 'Error: cargo not found and src/cel_engine.wasm missing' && exit 1; fi
